details.description: Dark mode state is not used in the UI. The outer container uses static bg-white/text-black classes so toggling darkMode has no visual effect.
details.fix_explanation: Apply conditional Tailwind classes based on darkMode state to the root container so toggling updates the theme.
details.after: <div className={`w-full min-h-screen p-4 transition-colors duration-300 ${darkMode ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white' : 'bg-white text-black'}`} >

details.description: Toggle button label is static (‘Toggle Dark Mode’) and does not reflect UI state, which is confusing.
details.fix_explanation:
Change button text to reflect current mode (e.g., Switch to Light Mode / Switch to Dark Mode).
Ensure the button has a proper accessible label.
details.before:
<button
    className="mb-4 px-2 py-1 border"
    onClick={() => setDarkMode(!darkMode)}
>
  Toggle Dark Mode
</button>
details.after:
<button
  type="button"
  className="mb-4 px-2 py-1 border rounded focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 transition-colors duration-200"
  aria-pressed={darkMode}
  onClick={() => setDarkMode(!darkMode)}
>
  {darkMode ? 'Switch to Light Mode' : 'Switch to Dark Mode'}
</button>

details.description: No loading indicator – metrics are empty initially and the UI shows blank content until set after timeout.
details.fix_explanation: Add isLoading state and display a loading indicator while metrics are being fetched.
details.before:
const [metrics, setMetrics] = useState<Metric[]>([]);
const [darkMode, setDarkMode] = useState(false);

details.description: Grid layout uses fixed columns (grid-cols-3) and is not responsive on small screens.
details.fix_explanation: Use responsive Tailwind classes (sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3) so layout adapts across breakpoints.
details.after: <div role="list" className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">

details.description: List items do not have semantic roles or accessible styles; screen readers benefit from role=
details.fix_explanation: Add role attributes and optional styling like rounded corners/shadow for better accessibility and perception.

details.description: Button lacks accessible attributes (type and aria-pressed) and focus ring styling.

details.description: Container uses w-screen h-screen which can cause overflow on mobile and miss min-height semantics.
details.fix_explanation: Use w-full min-h-screen so the container fills available space without forcing layout issues.
details.after: <div className={`w-full min-h-screen p-4 transition-colors duration-300 ${darkMode ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white' : 'bg-white text-black'}`} >
